metadata.name: Porites coral geochemical proxy record (Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca, δ18O, δ13C) from French Polynesia
metadata.description: High-resolution paleoclimate dataset containing geochemical measurements (Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca, δ18O, δ13C) from a single Porites coral core (TIAREI-3B) collected at -17.506944°, -149.4225° (French Polynesia) at 15 m depth in July 2008. The 91 samples span approximately 7.5 years (2000.125–2007.625 decimal years) with ~monthly resolution, providing proxy records for paleotemperature and environmental reconstruction.
